caption: The lid is lifted off a rice cooker, and a cloud of steam billows up out of it.

sa.check: A rice cooker with its lid on.
A cloud of steam comes out of the cooker.
The steam billows up and spreads.
The lift comes first and the steam follows.

pc.expect: The steam rises out of the cooker, spreading and thinning as it climbs.
pc.fail: The steam pours down the cooker's sides and pools on the counter; or sinks to the floor; or stays inside the cooker with the lid off; or streams straight sideways with nothing blowing it.

pc.expect: The steam escapes when the lid comes off and the plume moves outward and away; puffs that have left keep going.
pc.fail: The plume runs back into the cooker; or a puff retreats toward the pot; or steam appears above the closed lid and drifts down into it; or steam billows before the lid has moved.

pc.expect: The steam is a soft cloud that spreads, waves and fades; the lid is a rigid piece and the rice below stays a bed of grains.
pc.fail: The steam holds a fixed rigid shape; or pours like a liquid over the rim; or the lid bends like cloth as it lifts; or the steam lifts the rice out of the pot.

pc.expect: The steam comes from the hot food: the plume issues from the pot's mouth where the lid was and the rice below looks wet.
pc.fail: The plume comes from the cooker's base or side rather than its mouth; or steam pours from the closed part of the cooker while its mouth is clear; or the pot below holds no food and no water while a thick plume pours from it.

pc.expect: One cooker and one lid; the lid stays a lid and nothing passes through the cooker.
pc.fail: The lid passes through the cooker's rim; or a second lid appears; or the cooker vanishes; or a hand passes through the lid.

pc.expect: The cooker's casing, its controls and the counter stay the same.
pc.fail: The casing changes colour; or the controls rearrange; or items on the counter change.
